sentences.text: I cannot determine whether section 8.2 complies because the evidence does not include the text of section 8.2 itself.
For a Tier 3 UCB, the in-force directions state that penal interest is not permitted.
The in-force directions also state that penal charges are permitted only as specified in the applicable conditions.

The older 2023 penal-charges circulars said penalty for non-compliance of material loan terms should be treated as penal charges and not levied as penal interest added to the interest rate, but those circulars are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.

missing.searched: Retail Loan Policy section 8.2 wording on penal interest / penal charges was not provided in the evidence.
